jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Jobomschrijving

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have:
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly:
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.

You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.

We are a team of more than 74,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

Jobomschrijving

As part of the HR team, you will play a key role in supporting managers and employees on all operational and administrative HR matters. You will act as the first point of contact for Hard HR topics, ensuring compliance with local labour legislation, accuracy of HR data, and smooth execution of HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who wants to further develop expertise in Belgian labour law, HR administration, payroll coordination, and HR operations.

Employee Lifecycle Management

• Manage and coordinate all administrative HR processes from onboarding to offboarding.
• Prepare employment contracts, contract amendments, and other employment-related documents.
• Follow up on employee movements, including promotions, transfers, changes in working time, and organizational changes.

Payroll & Compensation Administration

• Act as the main point of contact for payroll administration and collaborate closely with the payroll provider.
• Follow up on absences, leave requests, time registration, and benefits administration.
• Support compensation and benefits administration and related documentation.

Labor Law & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with Belgian labour legislation, collective labour agreements, and internal policies.
• Monitor legislative changes and support the implementation of required updates.
• Provide first-line guidance to managers and employees on contractual and administrative HR matters.

HR Operations & Data Management

• Maintain accurate employee data in HR systems (Workday and other HR tools).
• Ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and compliance with GDPR requirements.
• Create and maintain HR procedures, policies, templates, and documentation.

Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and administrative efficiency.
• Support the digitalization and automation of HR activities.

Contribute to HR projects related to compliance, employee administration, and operational excellence.

• Master's degree, preferably in Human Resources, Business Administration, Payroll Administration or a related field
• Fluent in Dutch and French, both written and spoken; good command of English
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist, HR operations or payroll-related role
• Good knowledge of local legislation (knowledge of Luxembourg legislation is a plus)
• Good knowledge of Office tools (Outlook, Excel, Power point)
• Knowledge of Workday is a plus
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Strong analytical skills
• Comfortable working with digital HR systems, tools and process automation
• Results oriented
• Good administrative and organizational skills
• Open-minded, autonomous, flexible and proactive
• Able to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism

Are you an organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys being at the heart of office life? In this part-time role, you will support the daily operations of a busy international office, ensuring employees and visitors enjoy a seamless and welcoming workplace experience.

 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally active organisation with offices across multiple countries. Their Brussels team operates in a professional, collaborative and multicultural environment where efficiency, excellent service and teamwork are key to success.

As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a reliable Office Operations Assistant to help maintain smooth day-to-day office activities and provide essential administrative support.

 

Description

• Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answering calls and welcoming guests professionally.
• Provide administrative support including data entry, document preparation, proofreading and reporting.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, catering arrangements and logistics for internal meetings and events.
• Manage office supplies, kitchen stock, consumables and general workplace organisation.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries and courier services.
• Support facilities-related requests and liaise with external suppliers when needed.
• Assist with access badge administration, workspace set-up and daily office inspections.
• Prepare the office for opening and help maintain a clean, organised and professional working environment.
 

• You have at least 1 year of experience in administration, office coordination, reception or workplace support.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
• You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is considered an asset.
• You are highly organised, proactive and able to multitask effectively.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy supporting both colleagues and visitors.
• You are hands-on and willing to assist with practical office and facilities-related tasks.
• You are reliable, discreet and able to work independently.
• You are available to work on-site in Brussels on a part-time basis, Monday to Friday from 9AM to 1PM.

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

As a (Senior) Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.

Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.

A successful (Senior) Recruitment Consultant should have:

jobs.occupation: Inventory and Materials Specialist EMEA - Region of Ghent
jobs.description:

• Contribute to the development and improvement of inventory policies, procedures and best practices

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify optimisation opportunities and drive improvements
• Excellent Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems
• Strong communication skills and capable of interacting with international stakeholders at different levels
• Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an advantage
• Autonomous, proactive and able to take ownership in a fast-paced international environment

jobs.occupation: Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry
jobs.description:
Our client is a global veterinary health company specialized in the research, development, production, and marketing of pharmaceutical products and vaccines for companion animals and livestock market. With a presence in 50 countries, our client is recognized as one of the top animal health companies worldwide. 

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following responsibilities:

Veterinary Service Manager: 

• Serve as the technical expert for animal health products (pharma & vaccines) for poultry 
• Provide scientific and technical support to veterinarians, farmers, and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Conduct training sessions, seminars, round tables and product demonstrations for veterinarians, farmers and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Develop your network of Key Opinion Leader (KOLs) within the poultry sector in the Benelux region. 
• Support the launch of new products by highlighting the technical & scientific benefits of the new products. 

Internal Collaboration:

• Work closely with the Sales teams to enhance customer engagement for Poultry products.
• Collaborate with the marketing team in the BENEDACH by providing technical & scientific advice on the creation of marketing support.

Market analysis & awareness: 

• Organize and participate to events and congresses to develop your network within the animal health industry and the expand the pharma, medicines and vaccines visibility within the Poultry sector.
• Represent the company at conferences, trade shows, and professional events.
• Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging health challenges.
• Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following profile:

• Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) degree, Master Degree in Agriculture or equivalent.
• Experience / Knowledge in Poultry is mandatory. 
• You are autonomous with the willingness to travel in the Benelux region. 
• Ability to translate complex scientific information into practical guidance.
• Fluent in Dutch & English with a intermediate knowledge of French.

jobs.occupation: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
• Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
• Collective dismissals
• Employment regulations and policies
• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
• Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
• Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
• Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
• Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.
• Autonomous, confident, and able to express ideas proactively.
• Entrepreneurial attitude demonstrated through professional, academic, or extracurricular initiatives.
• International exposure or an additional relevant master's degree is considered a plus.
• Team player who thrives in a collaborative and non-competitive culture.
